measures.title: Renewal of Sales and Use Tax for Transportation Improvements (Mount Vernon Transportation Benefit District)
measures.what_it_does: Renews the Mount Vernon Transportation Benefit District's 0.2% sales and use tax for ten more years to pay for street repair, preservation and other transportation improvements in the city.
measures.cost_line: 0.2% sales and use tax (2 cents on $10), about $2.3 million a year; the current tax ends in April 2027 unless renewed.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.title: Annexation into Central Skagit Rural Partial-County Library District
measures.what_it_does: Annexes the City of Sedro-Woolley into the Central Skagit Rural Partial-County Library District, replacing the city's contract for library service with district membership.
measures.cost_line: District levy estimated at $0.232 per $1,000 of assessed value from 2028; the city plans to cut its own levy by up to $474,115, a net increase of about $11 in 2028 on a $519,450 home.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.title: Educational Facility Modernization and Technology Levy
measures.what_it_does: Authorizes a four-year capital levy to modernize existing school buildings and replace and upgrade technology systems.
measures.cost_line: $350,000 to $395,000 a year for 2027 through 2030 ($1,490,000 total), about $0.31 per $1,000 of assessed value.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.jurisdiction: Skagit County Fire Protection District No. 5
measures.title: Authorizing Regular Property Tax Levy
measures.what_it_does: Restores the fire district's regular property tax levy to $0.78 per $1,000 and lets it grow up to 3% a year for five years (Allen, Bow, Edison, Samish Island, Chuckanut Drive).
measures.cost_line: $0.78 per $1,000 of assessed value in 2027, then up to 3% more a year (never above $1.50).

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.
